# LitigaForge AI

> LitigaForge AI is a global AI-powered legal platform that connects clients with verified lawyers, delivers instant legal guidance, analyzes legal documents, and provides free legal aid — available 24/7 in English, Hindi, and Telugu.

## Platform Overview

LitigaForge AI makes legal help accessible to everyone. Using a multi-AI engine (Claude Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5), the platform provides immediate, accurate legal answers, intelligently matches clients with the right verified advocate, and handles the full lifecycle of a legal case — from initial question to resolved matter.

## Core Features

- [Legal Q&A with AI](/ask): Ask any legal question and receive an instant, AI-generated plain-language answer. Questions and answers are stored in a community knowledge base.
- [Document Analyzer](/review): Paste or upload any legal document — contract, FIR, court notice, employment letter — to get an AI risk score, missing-clause detection, and actionable recommendations.
- [AI Lawyer Matching](/lawyers): Post case requirements and receive AI-matched verified advocates scored 0–100 with detailed explanations of why each lawyer fits.
- [Judgment Finder](/judgments): Search court judgments and case law by keyword, court name, or case number. Returns up to 5 relevant precedents with citation links for the user's jurisdiction.
- [AI Legal Chat](/legal-chat): Interactive legal drafting assistant with templates for contracts, notices, affidavits, and petitions. Powered by Claude Sonnet.
- [Free Legal Documents](/free-documents): 10+ downloadable AI-powered document templates — rental agreements, legal notices, affidavits, employment letters — generated free of charge.
- [Free Legal Aid Finder](/legal-aid): Eligibility wizard + contact details and toll-free helplines for free legal aid services in the user's country.
- [Subscription Plans](/subscription): Free tier (5 AI queries/month), Professional ₹999/month (unlimited queries), Advocate Pro ₹2,499/month (full practice management).

## Target Users

- Individuals seeking legal guidance in India and globally
- Small businesses needing contract review and legal consultation
- Verified advocates managing client cases, documents, and hearings
- NGOs and legal aid organizations
- International users with India-related legal matters (NRIs, foreign companies)

## Geographic Coverage

Worldwide. Country-specific legal content for: India, United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Australia, Canada, Singapore, and Germany.

## Languages

English, Telugu, Hindi

## Technology

- AI Models: Anthropic Claude Sonnet, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, OpenAI GPT-5 (cascading fallback)
- Backend: Python 3.12 / FastAPI
- Frontend: React 19 / Vite / Tailwind CSS
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Auth: JWT (30-day tokens), bcrypt password hashing

## Legal Disclaimer

LitigaForge AI provides legal information for educational purposes. It is not a substitute for advice from a qualified advocate. For serious legal matters, users are encouraged to consult a verified lawyer via the platform's matching service.
